Database.//SchemaStrategy: MUST be EnsureCreated whenever Provider is Sqlite: the committed migrations are PostgreSQL-authored (the single migrated provider), so applying them to SQLite would emit the wrong DDL. Production sets Provider=Postgres with SchemaStrategy=Migrate.

Cors.//: Exact origins of the dashboard. Wildcards are refused at startup. Empty = no cross-origin access (same-origin deployments need nothing here).
